in_arabic.name: أيسر
in_arabic.long_meaning: أيسر هو اسم عربي مشتق من الجذر الأي س ر، والذي يعني الخير والبركة والنعمة، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الهداية والإرشاد، وهو اسم شائع في الثقافة الإسلامية ويحمل معنىً روحياً عميقاً يتعلق بالتوفيق والسداد

in_urdu.name: ایسر
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایسر ایک عربي نام ہے جو جڑھ اے س ر سے اخذ کیا گیا ہے، جس کا معنیٰ خیر و برکت و نعمت ہے، اور قرآن پاک میں ہدایت و رہنمائی کے سیاق و سباق میں ذکر ہوا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت مشہور ہے اور روحانی معنیٰ رکھتا ہے جو کامیابی اور سعادت سے متعلق ہے

in_hindi.name: अय्सर
in_hindi.long_meaning: अय्सर एक अरबी नाम है जो जड़ ऐ स र से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ खैर और बरकत और नेमत है, और कुरान में मार्गदर्शन और दिशा के संदर्भ में उल्लेख किया गया है, यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है और गहरा आध्यात्मिक अर्थ रखता है जो सफलता और समृद्धि से संबंधित है

in_pashto.name: ایسر
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایسر د عربي نوم دی چې د اې س ر څخه اخیستل شوی، چې معنیٰ یې ښېګڼه او برکت او نېمت دی، او قرآن کریم کی د ځانګړي لارښود په اړه یاد شوی، دا نوم په اسلامی کلتور کی ډېر مشهور دی او د ځانګړي روحاني معنی لرونکی دی چې د بریالیتوب او کامیابۍ سره تړاو لري

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Aysar is considered a noble and virtuous name as it signifies a person who is helpful and supportive. This quality is highly valued in Islamic society, as it promotes harmony, unity and compassion amongst the community. The name Aysar is a reminder of the Islamic principle, "None of you will believe, till he desires for his brother that which he desires for himself." (al-Bukhari). Thus, the name represents an ideal character and behavior that Muslims should strive towards.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aysar holds a profound significance as it reflects the concept of 'khilafah' or vicegerency of God on earth. Being helpful and supportive is an expression of God's qualities and a way of serving and pleasing Him. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Jannah is under the shade of the thornless shadda tree, or the thorny shadda tree, or the shadda tree of Paradise; a tree that is as wide as it is deep and its branches spread out on earth like the span of Allah's Hand." (Bukhari and Muslim). Therefore, the name Aysar is a reminder of the spiritual duty of providing support and help, not only to one's fellow brothers and sisters but also to the needy and the deprived, thereby contributing towards building a righteous and God-conscious society.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah, vol. 8, p. 203-204 The name Aysar carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aysar bin Abi Jarrah, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), was one of the ten pioneers who emigrated to Abyssinia (Ethiopia) to escape persecution in Mecca. He was a strong and brave man, known for his deep faith and commitment to Islam. When the Muslims returned to Mecca after the Prophet's migration to Medina, Aysar was among the first to join the Battle of Badr.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Tabari's Tarikh al-Rusul wa al-Muluk, vol. 2, p. 200 The name Aysar carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aysar bin Abi Jarrah was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) in the early days of Islam in Mecca. He was known for his belief in Islam and his active role in spreading the message of the Prophet. When the Prophet received the first revelation in the cave of Hira, Aysar was among the first to believe in him and support him.
